description: Verify a webhook event signature via POST /v1/notifications/verify-webhook-signature. Pass the headers and body received on your webhook endpoint. Returns verification_status SUCCESS or FAILURE.

auth_algo.description: PayPal-Auth-Algo header from the webhook request.

cert_url.description: PayPal-Cert-Url header from the webhook request.

webhook_event.description: The full webhook event JSON body as received.

webhook_id.description: Configured webhook id receiving the event.

name: verify_webhook_signature
